_how: graded blind on crops (results/free/n0-25b/*), 4 tiles per person, before opening moments_key.json; per tile: P = a player on the pitch (incl. keeper), N = not a player (bench/coach/spectator/object), ? = can't tell (ring at the picture's edge or between people)
sfk00: NNNP  bench staff by the far touchline
sfk01: PNPP  wide player, once the empty spot in front of the bench
sfk02: PPPP  white wide player on the far line
sfk03: PPPP  dark player at the far line (throw-in)
sfk04: PNNP  players, twice the seated bench people
sfk06: NNNP  coach in dark clothes at the bench / bin
sfk12: NNNN  coach in dark clothes at the bench
sfk13: ?PP?  white player near goal line, keeper
sfk15: NNNN  two people seated on the far bench
sfk17: PPPP  white player near the far corner
aik00: NNN?  spectators behind the far line
aik03: PPPP  red-shirted player at the post at a corner
aik07: NNN?  spectators in front of the spare goal
aik09: NNNN  person in dark standing still at the far line by the stand
aik10: NNNP  spectators in front of the spare goal, then a player
aik11: PPPP  dark player near the camera
aik13: NNN?  spectators in front of the spare goal
aik16: ?PP?  dark player at the far line by the stand
aik17: NNN?  a bag / ball lying by the clubhouse fence
